questions.q: Which two parameters are required on every aws ec2 run-instances call?
options: --image-id and --instance-type
--key-name and --security-group-ids
--subnet-id and --count
--block-device-mappings and --key-name
questions.explain: run-instances always needs to know which AMI to boot from and what hardware profile to use; the rest can fall back to defaults.

questions.q: If a run-instances call omits --subnet-id, what does AWS do?
options: Launches into a default subnet of the account's default VPC
Refuses to launch the instance at all
Launches the instance with no network interface
Automatically creates a brand-new VPC for the instance
questions.explain: AWS falls back to a default subnet in the default VPC, which may not exist or may not be where a production instance should live — that's why specifying it explicitly matters.

questions.q: What is an elastic network interface (ENI)?
options: The virtual network card attached to an instance inside a subnet
The physical cable connecting an AWS data center to the internet
A type of EBS volume used for networked storage
A load balancer that distributes traffic across instances
questions.explain: Every EC2 instance gets an ENI when it launches — it's the virtual NIC that lives inside whichever subnet you specified.

questions.q: What determines whether a subnet is public or private?
options: Whether its route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to an internet gateway
Whether the subnet's name contains the word "public"
Whether the instance in it has a key pair assigned
Whether the subnet is in the us-east-1 region
questions.explain: A subnet is public specifically because its route table routes internet-bound traffic to an internet gateway — it's a routing fact, not a label.

questions.q: Why does the network decision at launch time matter before the instance even boots?
options: It decides whether the instance can get a reachable public IP at all
It decides which operating system the instance will run
It decides how much the instance costs per hour
It has no real effect until security groups are configured
questions.explain: Launching into a public subnet with auto-assign public IP enabled gives the instance a reachable address immediately; a private subnet gives it no direct internet path by design.
